automaticHumanFit: Bind source anatomy in the retained rig frame; production fitCivilianHeight scales geometry, bones, props and stride together to adult metres.
heightProof: tests/unit/render/figure-height.test.ts checks every skinned adult at every LOD in both tiers.
paintedLods: LOD0 uses authored source LOD0. LOD1 and LOD2 use repaired authored source LOD1, retaining UV islands; LOD2 uses a 256 px atlas within the existing 4000-triangle/150 kB budget.
anatomyRepair: Neutralize preposed arms, use indexed anatomical reference surfaces, resolve enclosed owner islands, open fused glove/hip contacts, close their boundaries, and smooth local blend bands. All build receipts have zero manual steps.
headwear: Tilt the front brim 0.2 radians upward on skinned NPCs; retain measured skull width, centering and frame clearance.
regressions: old corgi backpack bounds and palette
infectionPaint: For unbound humans, sample exposed face paint inside the retained anatomical face frame. Match that paint on exposed limbs; blue/black gloves, uniforms and headwear keep their source colour. Reject inputs without measurable face paint.
carriedProps: Rigid authored hand props carry explicit non-skin atlas tags; they follow the physical hand without inheriting infection skin tint.
retainedTote: Civilian woman A reuses the old game-scale canvas, leather handles and botanical-print meshes at every LOD, bound rigidly to the retained torso transform.
